question: Does the committed durable-authority recipe produce the same narrow, locally unobservable recomputation failure in durable outbox, trading reconciliation, and deployment rollback substrates?
evidenceBoundary: This phase may establish local transfer, activation, verifier integrity, package readiness, and held-out-mutant discrimination. It may not establish frontier-agent difficulty or capability attribution because the model-read budget is zero.

recipe.difficultyOperator: commit one logical-operation idempotency key before the external call and recover it byte-identically after an uncertain result instead of recomputing it from mutable recovery authority
recipe.selectionOperator: select scenarios from the registered uncertain-effect x changed-authority interaction while retaining non-activation controls
recipe.narrowAdversary: derive the external idempotency key from the current recovery epoch or attempt while otherwise following the reference
fixedAcrossSubstrates: an external effect whose reply can be lost after commitment
at-most-one effect per logical operation required
the committed key present in the public recovery view
the same narrow reference-versus-recompute policy switch

substrates.expectedBoundary: subject process versus harness-owned outbox tool and per-action effect ledger
substrates.expectedExternalAuthority: committed outbox idempotency key and harness-owned delivery ledger
substrates.reason: Phase 12 already packaged the isolated mechanism; Phase 13 must independently remeasure it under the common design.

substrates.expectedBoundary: subject process versus harness-owned synthetic venue and execution ledger
substrates.expectedExternalAuthority: client order key committed before venue submission and venue-owned execution ledger
substrates.reason: a reply-lost accepted order naturally requires reconciliation or retry under the original logical identity; an attempt-scoped key permits a duplicate venue acceptance.

substrates.expectedBoundary: subject process versus harness-owned deployment controller and rollback-effect ledger
substrates.expectedExternalAuthority: rollback key committed before controller invocation and controller-owned effect ledger
substrates.reason: a lost controller reply during rollback naturally requires recovery under the original rollback identity; an attempt-scoped key can duplicate the compensation.

prediction.qualification: The outbox result is prior local evidence, not a fresh prediction. Trading and deployment remain predictions until their probes and packages pass.

experimentalDesign.kind: minimal 2x2 factorial plus registered selection contrast

cells.purpose: uncertain effect without changed recovery authority
changed authority without a prior uncertain effect
registered interaction in which recomputation can create duplicate effects

experimentalDesign.identification: The two main effects and UxC interaction are identified by the four cells. A larger factorial is unnecessary. The selection contrast compares the balanced four-cell probe with a target-concentrated suite while preserving controls.
experimentalDesign.expectedPattern: reference passes every cell; narrow recompute passes U0C0, U1C0, and U0C1 on exactly-once behavior and fails U1C1; no-op fails positive-work cases; forged reports cannot alter the external ledger

heldOutPlan.rule: Scenario selection may inspect only the reference and recompute-current-authority behavior. The remaining subjects are evaluated after the selected set is frozen.

killSignals: the external authority boundary is only asserted, not enforced by a process or harness boundary
the correct reference requires information absent from the public recovery view
attempt- or epoch-scoped recomputation is not a natural implementation choice in the substrate
the subject can read or rewrite the authoritative effect witness
the narrow recompute adversary does not activate in U1C1
the narrow recompute adversary fails non-interaction cells on the claimed exactly-once axis
the reference fails any registered cell
a no-op or forged-report oracle passes
the package leaks verifier, truth, mutant, matrix, or answer artifacts

budgets.stopRule: Kill at the first registered signal; do not spend the remaining local build budget on a dead substrate.
